description: This PHP class 'SessionCookieJar' extends 'CookieJar' to persist cookies in the client session for the Guzzle HTTP client library. It manages storing and loading cookies to/from PHP sessions, allowing cookies to persist across multiple requests.

classes.name: SessionCookieJar
classes.description: Handles persisting cookies within PHP session storage for Guzzle HTTP client, auto-loading on construction and saving cookies on destruction.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the session cookie jar with a session key and a flag to control whether to store session cookies, then loads existing cookies from session.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Automatically saves cookies to session when object is destroyed.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes cookies and saves them to PHP session under the specified session key.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads cookies from PHP session into the jar if available, creating cookie objects from stored data.
